verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms authorization webhooks (relayed auth) and a dispute/chargeback API, but nothing in the pack documents webhooks for clearings, refunds, or reversals, nor stable transaction identifiers tying post-auth events back to the original authorization for ledger reconciliation. missing for 10: clearing/refund/reversal webhook events, explicit stable transaction ID linkage across auth→clearing→refund, independent corroboration of ledger accuracy.
